about.title: Built for restaurants, not around them.
about.subtitle: We are building the operating system the restaurant industry has been missing.
about.intro: SYNORA was created to solve one problem: restaurants run on too many disconnected tools. Orders get lost between the cashier and the kitchen, numbers never add up at the end of the day, and owners only learn what happened after it already did. We build one system that connects every part of the restaurant — orders, kitchen, payments, tables and analytics — so the data flows automatically and the owner always knows what is happening.

cards.title: One system
cards.text: POS, kitchen, payments, tables and reports live together. Nothing is copied between tools, because there is only one source of truth.

cards.title: AI-native by design
cards.text: AI is not an add-on. It reads your own restaurant's data to explain what happened, why it happened and what to do next.

cards.title: Private and secure
cards.text: Your data belongs to you. Tenants are isolated, secrets stay encrypted and data is never shared or sold.

cards.title: Serving restaurants first
cards.text: We measure success by how much time and money the system saves the people who run real restaurants.

values: We ship the features restaurants actually use — the rest stays off the roadmap.
We never invent numbers. Every report and recommendation comes from real order data.
We keep the system fast, even when the floor is at its busiest.
We listen to the kitchen, the waiters and the owners — not just to the loudest voice.

docs.title: SYNORA API documentation
docs.subtitle: Everything you need to integrate your own tools with the SYNORA platform.
docs.introText: Every resource follows the same patterns: JSON in and JSON out, authenticated with a bearer token, scoped to your restaurant. WebSockets keep the kitchen board live in real time. This page documents the public surface of the platform as it exists today.
docs.baseText: All API endpoints are versioned and served under /api/v1.
docs.authText: Register or sign in to receive a JWT access token. Send it as a Bearer token on every request. Refresh tokens rotate automatically in an httpOnly cookie.

authSteps.title: Register
authSteps.text: Create a workspace with POST /auth/register to get an access token in the response.

authSteps.title: Authenticate
authSteps.text: Send the token on every request: Authorization: Bearer <token>.

authSteps.title: Refresh
authSteps.text: When a token expires, call POST /auth/refresh with the refresh cookie and a fresh token pair is issued.

docs.endpointsText: Preview of the core API surface.

items.note: Create a workspace and get tokens

docs.wsText: Connect with a Bearer token and an optional branch filter to receive kitchen events as they happen.
docs.securityText: JWT access tokens are short-lived, refresh tokens rotate on every use, and all state is scoped to a single restaurant tenant. Nothing can be read or written outside your own workspace. Passwords and tokens are stored as hashes — the platform never stores plain text secrets.
docs.swaggerText: An interactive OpenAPI explorer is available at /api/docs while running in development and staging environments.
docs.swaggerNote: Production environments deliberately disable the interactive explorer to reduce the attack surface.

help.title: Get started with SYNORA
help.subtitle: The essentials you need to run the busiest shift without thinking twice.

getting.title: Create your workspace
getting.text: Register to create your restaurant and add your teammates as staff accounts with their own roles.

getting.title: Build your menu
getting.text: Add categories and products with prices from the Menu module. Products without a category are included in the list.

getting.title: Set up tables
getting.text: Add the tables on your floor so orders can be placed at a seat instead of a generic counter.

getting.title: Open a cash shift
getting.text: Before the first payment of the day, open a cash shift with an opening balance so the end-of-day numbers reconcile.

getting.title: Place the first order
getting.text: Create an order, add products, send it to the kitchen and watch the ticket appear on the live kitchen board.

tasks.title: Track the kitchen in real time
tasks.text: Open the Kitchen module. New orders land on the board instantly over a live connection and move as you update them.

tasks.title: Accept Payme payments
tasks.text: On an open order, use Pay online. A Payme checkout opens in a new tab and the order is marked paid automatically once the payment succeeds.

tasks.title: Settle the day
tasks.text: Close the cash shift, compare the expected balance with the drawer and review payments recorded across the day.

tasks.title: Reset a forgotten password
tasks.text: Use the forgot-password link at sign-in. A single-use link is emailed to you and expires within 45 minutes.

tasks.title: Swap branches
tasks.text: Branch filters in the dashboard, orders and kitchen let you run every location from the same workspace.
